sn37.32:2.1: pañcimāni bhikkhave ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.4: idampi bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.5: paṭirūpe kule jāyitvā paṭirūpaṃ kulaṃ gaccheyyanti
sn37.32:2.6: idampi bhikkhave dutiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.7: paṭirūpe kule jāyitvā paṭirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyanti
sn37.32:2.8: idampi bhikkhave tatiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.9: paṭirūpe kule jāyitvā paṭirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti
sn37.32:2.10: idampi bhikkhave catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.11: paṭirūpe kule jāyitvā paṭirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapatti agāraṃ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṃ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti
sn37.32:2.12: idampi bhikkhave pañcamaṃ ṭhānaṃ sulabhaṃ katapuññena mātugāmena.
sn37.32:2.13: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmenāti.
